title: Component props
summary: Props are inputs passed from a parent component to a child component.
whenToUse: Use props when a child component needs data or configuration from the component that renders it.
commonMistake: Trying to change props inside the child component instead of asking the parent to update state.
interviewQuestion: Are props mutable inside a component?
interviewAnswer: No. Props are read-only from the child component's point of view; state changes should happen in the owner component.

title: The children prop
summary: children contains the JSX placed between a component's opening and closing tags.
whenToUse: Use children for wrapper components, layout components, reusable boxes, and flexible composition.
commonMistake: Creating many specific props when children would make the component more flexible.
interviewQuestion: What is the children prop used for?
interviewAnswer: children lets a component receive and render nested JSX, making composition more flexible.
